stalls.where: 城隍廟前（中山路75號一帶）
stalls.summaryZh: 城隍廟口排隊老店，餡料有高麗菜、豆芽、肉鬆與花生粉，口味清爽、性價比高，也有素食版。
stalls.summaryEn: A long-queued old stall at the temple front. Rolls of cabbage, sprouts, pork floss and peanut powder taste light and are good value; a vegan version is offered.

stalls.where: 北門街35號（城隍廟北側，步行數分鐘）
stalls.summaryZh: 從午後開到深夜的鴨肉老店，胡椒與醬汁下得重、肉量大方，炒鴨血酸辣夠味，是宵夜熱門選擇。
stalls.summaryEn: Duck specialist open from late morning into the small hours. Heavy on pepper and sauce with generous meat; the tangy-spicy duck blood is a favorite, especially late at night.

stalls.where: 中山路142號（距廟約3分鐘步行）
stalls.summaryZh: 鴨肉蒸過再燻、淋鴨油醬汁，香氣層次多、份量實在，平日假日都要排隊；週二、三公休。
stalls.summaryEn: Steamed-then-smoked duck over rice with duck-oil sauce: layered aroma and solid portions. Queues on weekdays and weekends alike; closed Tue and Wed.

stalls.summaryZh: 拳頭大的芋泥球現點現炸，外殼薄脆、芋泥綿密不過甜，備料費工。
stalls.summaryEn: Fist-sized taro balls fried to order: thin crisp shell, smooth taro filling that isn't too sweet, and a labor-intensive prep.

美人計｜新竹城隍廟美食必吃推薦

stalls.summaryZh: 城隍廟『過五關』常見的一站，手工米粉淋肉燥，Q彈鹹香，配清爽的綜合湯。
stalls.summaryEn: A classic stop on the temple's food crawl: handmade rice noodles under minced-pork gravy, chewy and savory, with a light mixed soup.

foods: 燒麻糬（紅豆、芝麻、花生、原味）
foodsEn: warm mochi (red bean, sesame, peanut, plain)
stalls.summaryZh: 現做麻糬外皮軟糯、裹滿花生粉，外帶人潮多但出餐快；週三公休。
stalls.summaryEn: Fresh mochi with a soft, chewy skin rolled in peanut powder; busy with takeaway but quick. Closed Wednesdays.

sources.title: 小兔小安｜2025新竹城隍廟美食10間
美人計｜新竹城隍廟美食必吃推薦

stalls.summaryZh: 肉包內餡用五花與梅花肉先炒後滷，醬香偏甜；珍奶包珍珠多、甜度適中，常需久等。
stalls.summaryEn: Pork buns filled with belly and shoulder meat stir-fried then braised, with a sweetish sauce; the bubble-tea bun is packed with pearls and not too sweet. Expect waits.

sources.title: 小兔小安｜2025新竹城隍廟美食10間
美人計｜新竹城隍廟美食必吃推薦

stalls.summaryZh: 蚵仔新鮮、大小適中，邊緣煎得焦脆；也有人覺得醬汁偏重、局部煎得太焦。
stalls.summaryEn: Fresh, well-sized oysters with crispy edges; some find the sauce heavy and parts over-charred.

sources.title: 小兔小安｜2025新竹城隍廟美食10間

stalls.zh: 桂紅茯苓糕・白色麥芽餅
foodsEn: white malt-candy cracker with cilantro & peanut
stalls.summaryZh: 傳統麥芽餅夾花生粉與香菜，口感有層次，茯苓糕鬆軟；藝人推薦後常有人潮，週一公休。
stalls.summaryEn: Old-style malt-candy crackers with peanut powder and cilantro for contrasting textures, plus fluffy poria cake. Often crowded after celebrity mentions; closed Mondays.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜新竹城隍廟口7攤必吃

stalls.summaryZh: 綠豆沙打得綿密細緻、甜度適中，可加珍珠，是逛完小吃的解膩飲品。
stalls.summaryEn: Smooth, finely blended mung bean milk with moderate sweetness and optional pearls; a popular palate cleanser after snacking.

sources.title: 輕旅行｜8間城隍廟小吃推薦
美人計｜新竹城隍廟美食必吃推薦

stalls.summaryZh: 肉燥肥而Q、帶胡椒香，滷鴨蛋和滷白菜常被加點，控肉軟嫩小孩也愛。
stalls.summaryEn: Fatty, springy braised pork with a peppery kick; the duck egg and braised cabbage are popular add-ons, and the tender pork belly wins over kids.

stalls.en: Ya Zhen Hao Ge-Ge Thick Soup
foodsEn: Mixed thick soup (fish cake, pork, squid)
stalls.summaryZh: 一碗羹裡有魚漿、肉、魷魚等多種配料，口感豐富；芋頭肉圓也很推。
stalls.summaryEn: One bowl of thick soup loaded with fish paste, pork, squid and more for lots of textures; the taro meatballs are also recommended.

sources.title: 新竹城隍廟美食Top11（波比看世界）
2025新竹城隍廟夜市必吃小吃（兔兒毛毛姊妹花）

stalls.summaryZh: 大顆梅花造型雞蛋糕，外層香脆、內裡鬆軟偏甜；先抽號碼牌再等。也有人覺得蛋香不足。
stalls.summaryEn: Big plum-blossom egg cakes, crisp outside and fluffy, sweet inside — take a number first. Some find the egg flavor faint.

sources.title: 新竹城隍廟美食Top11（波比看世界）
2025新竹城隍廟夜市必吃小吃（兔兒毛毛姊妹花）
新竹城隍廟周邊8間必吃懶人包（ETtoday）

stalls.where: 廟旁（中山路75號一帶），週二公休
stalls.summaryZh: 號稱百年的肉圓老攤，皮Q微脆，有蔥、芋頭、筍子等內餡，芋頭口味最受歡迎。
stalls.summaryEn: A reputedly century-old meatball stall with chewy, slightly crisp skins and scallion, taro or bamboo fillings; taro is the favorite.

sources.title: 2025新竹城隍廟夜市必吃小吃（兔兒毛毛姊妹花）

stalls.summaryZh: 廟口人氣最旺的蚵仔煎之一，排隊很長，蚵仔給得多、邊緣煎得酥脆。
stalls.summaryEn: One of the busiest stalls in the temple court, with long lines for its generously stuffed, crisp-edged oyster omelet.

sources.title: 2025新竹城隍廟夜市必吃小吃（兔兒毛毛姊妹花）

stalls.summaryZh: 炸肉圓搭甜鹹醬汁最受好評，蚵仔煎普通；座位乾淨有冷氣。
stalls.summaryEn: The fried meatballs with sweet-savory sauce are the star while the oyster omelet is just average; clean, air-conditioned seating.

sources.title: 2025新竹城隍廟夜市必吃小吃（兔兒毛毛姊妹花）

foodsEn: Spring roll with spicy bean sauce
stalls.summaryZh: 餡料飽滿、高麗菜爽脆，自製辣味豆醬是亮點，整體不會太鹹。
stalls.summaryEn: Generously filled with crunchy cabbage; the house spicy bean sauce is the highlight and it isn't overly salty.

sources.title: 新竹城隍廟周邊8間必吃懶人包（ETtoday）

stalls.summaryZh: 廟口周邊的伴手禮老店，水蒸蛋糕以肉鬆口味最受推薦。
stalls.summaryEn: An old souvenir bakery near the temple; the pork-floss steamed sponge cake is the top pick.

sources.title: 新竹城隍廟美食Top11（波比看世界）

stalls.summaryZh: 清朝創立、傳承四代的餅舖，竹塹餅是傳統口味的新竹伴手禮。
stalls.summaryEn: A Qing-era bakery now in its fourth generation, known for the traditional Zhuqian cake souvenir.

sources.title: 新竹城隍廟美食Top11（波比看世界）

stalls.where: 廟旁西市場內（西安街70號），週四公休
stalls.summaryZh: 藏在廟旁市場裡的沙茶火鍋老店，新鮮牛肉最受好評，環境樸實。
stalls.summaryEn: A no-frills shacha hot pot spot inside the market beside the temple, praised for its fresh beef.
